description: This file defines the interface for big number (BIGNUM) cryptographic operations, including data structures, macros, and function prototypes for arbitrary-precision arithmetic used in cryptography.

classes.name: BIGNUM
classes.description: Represents an arbitrary-precision integer used in cryptographic calculations.

classes.name: BN_CTX
classes.description: Context structure for managing temporary BIGNUM variables during calculations.

classes.name: BN_MONT_CTX
classes.description: Context for Montgomery multiplication used in modular exponentiation.

classes.name: BN_RECP_CTX
classes.description: Context for reciprocal division and modular reduction.

methods.name: BN_value_one
methods.description: Returns a BIGNUM representing the value one.

methods.name: BN_options
methods.description: Returns configuration options for BIGNUM operations.

methods.name: BN_bin2bn
methods.description: Converts binary data to a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_bn2bin
methods.description: Converts a BIGNUM to binary data.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_mont
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation using Montgomery multiplication.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_mont_word
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation with a word base using Montgomery.

methods.name: BN_reciprocal
methods.description: Calculates the reciprocal of a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_rshift1
methods.description: Right shifts a BIGNUM by one.

methods.name: BN_set_bit
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_clear_bit
methods.description: Clears a specific bit in a BIGNUM.

methods.name: BN_is_prime
methods.description: Checks if a number is prime.

methods.name: BN_MONT_CTX_set
methods.description: Initializes a Montgomery context with a modulus.

methods.name: BN_set_params
methods.description: Sets global parameters for BIGNUM operations.

methods.name: BN_get_params
methods.description: Gets global parameters for BIGNUM operations.

methods.name: BN_RECP_CTX_set
methods.description: Sets a reciprocal context with divisor.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_recp
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation using reciprocal division.
